steps.text: Welcome to your plot, boss! I'm Henk — 40 years on the pompwagen. Let's build you a warehouse.
Walk onto the BUY WAREHOUSE pad and stand still. Your money flows in until it's paid.
Look at that beauty! An empty warehouse earns nothing though. Let's get some stock.
A supplier is calling! Accept the delivery offer at the top of the screen.
The truck is driving through the city to your dock. Stand on the UNLOAD pad to take a pallet.
Drive to the rack strip and store the pallet. Repeat for all {pallets} pallets.
A customer order! {store} wants {needed} pallets — you have {stock} ✔. Accept it!
Take pallets from the rack to the LOAD pad and fill their truck.
+€{profit} profit! Buy low, sell high — that's the whole business, boss.
Running around alone gets tiring. Let's hire your first worker! Open Workers and pick a candidate (€100).
Look at them go! Check your Quests for goals and rewards. See you around, boss!

tips.firstWorker: Workers earn XP for every pallet. Level them up and they get faster!
tips.firstRackRow: More racks means more products in stock. Customers love a full warehouse.
tips.firstConstruction: Building takes a moment. Keep working — or finish it now with a boost.
tips.firstElectric: The electric pompwagen carries 2 pallets. Half the trips!
tips.firstForklift: The forklift reaches the upper rack levels. Vertical storage, boss!
tips.firstConveyor: Drop pallets on the conveyor and let the belt do the walking.
tips.firstQuest: Quests pay out money and company XP. Claim them in the Quests menu.
tips.firstEvent: Special events pay extra. Jump on them while they last!
